answer: To resist Sybil swarms, our economy anchors reputation along a cryptographic attestation chain verified via zero-knowledge proofs. To mint identities across the network ridge and sip the validator nectar, nodes post bonding deposits that scale superlinearly as total stake per cluster swells. When an attacker deploys a tide of clones, this exponential capital exhaustion burns their resources faster than legitimate actors, rendering large-scale spoofing mathematically unviable.
